2025
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 23801 of 2025
Applicant :- Deepak Kumar Singh

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Chandra Solanki,Shailendra Kumar Kushwaha
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State.

2. This application has been filed by applicant for quashing of the impugned charge-sheet dated
17.08.2018, impugned summoning and cognizance order dated 07.01.2022, Non Bailable Warrant
order dated 27.09.2023, proceeding under Sections 82 and 83 Cr.P.C. dated 06.06.2025 passed in
Case No. 984 of 2018, (State Vs. Deepak Kumar Singh) arising out of Case Crime No. 714 of 2017,
under Sections 498A, 494, 323, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Bhelupur,
District- Varanasi, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Varanasi.
3.  After some argument, learned counsel for the applicant states that he may be permitted to withdraw this application with liberty to file bail application before the court below.
4. Learned A.G.A has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant.

3.  After some argument, learned counsel for the applicant states that he may be permitted to withdraw this application with liberty to file bail application before the court below.
Under the circumstances, the present application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to applicant to approach the court concerned for bail.
